The user wants a summary of the provided YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences, and absolutely no English.
Key points from the transcript:
1. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang held an impromptu mini press conference with Korean reporters in Taipei after GTC Taipei
2. He praised Korean companies' achievements, especially SK Hynix's HBM, emphasizing close relationship between NVIDIA and SK Hynix
3. He mentioned Korean companies are smart and technologically advanced, specifically mentioning robotics as next-gen technology where NVIDIA wants to contribute
4. He said he would personally come to Seoul to hold GTC if Korea wants it, expressing affection for Korea since GeForce early days, praising imagination, creativity, and ambition
5. He distributed chicken to reporters and citizens
6. Attendees at the gathering included executives from SK Hynix, Naver Cloud, Samsung Electronics, LG Science Park
7. He will meet with Korean conglomerate heads (SK Group Chairman, LG Group Chairman, Naver Chairman) starting from the 5th, while Hyundai Motor Group Chairman is coordinating schedule and Samsung Electronics Chairman is absent due to overseas schedule
8. Likely dinner location is a pork belly restaurant in Seongsu-dong
